AI Foundry — Structure & Operating Framework

1. Purpose and Overview

AI Foundry is Coopbank’s structured operating framework for delivering AI-driven transformation. It establishes a disciplined, repeatable workflow that converts ideas into measurable business outcomes. By combining human expertise, modern AI tools, and transparent governance, AI Foundry ensures every AI initiative—from automation to analytics—is delivered with clarity, speed, and accountability.

2. Why AI Foundry Exists

AI transformation often fails when technology is pursued without process discipline. AI Foundry provides a unified operating model to ensure measurable impact and consistent delivery across all AI initiatives at Coopbank. It delivers:

Standardized workflows for all transformation projects

Clear, accountable roles and responsibilities

Transparent progress tracking through shared backlogs and audit trails

Repeatable, scalable results—eliminating one-off experiments

AI Foundry enables AI transformation to function like any strategic business system: structured, transparent, outcome-driven, and accountable.

3. Team Structure and Responsibilities

A. Business Innovation Team

Focused on defining and validating problems and solutions before development.

Key Responsibilities:

• Diagnose current business processes

• Redesign processes through automation and AI

• Identify and validate assumptions through experimentation

B. Engineering Team

Transforms validated ideas into enterprise-scale solutions while ensuring system integrity.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop detailed technical specifications

• Build and deploy AI-powered platforms

• Manage data pipelines, analytics infrastructure, and CI/CD

C. Adoption & Outcomes Team

Ensures solutions deliver value through effective change management and adoption.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead stakeholder communication and rollout

• Deliver staff training and capability building

• Track adoption metrics and business outcomes

4.

4. AI Foundry Workflow (Nine-Step Process)

Diagnose – Understand the current state and define the root problem

Redesign – Reimagine the process using AI and automation

Test Assumptions – Validate high-risk ideas via experiments and MVPs

Specify – Produce detailed technical specifications

Build – Engineer scalable AI solutions

Analyse – Define metrics and measure performance

Plan Rollout – Prepare communication and change-management plans

Train & Implement – Equip staff to adopt new tools and workflows

Monitor & Improve – Continuously enhance systems based on real-world outcomes

6.

Guiding Principles

Spec Before Tech — Define the “what” before coding the “how.”

Best for Bank — Prioritize long-term strategic outcomes.

Reinvention, Not Digitisation — Redesign processes from the ground up; don’t digitize inefficiency.

Outcomes Over Outputs — Focus on measurable value, not activity.

Follow the Process — Maintain transparency and consistency; avoid shortcuts.

Speed — Deliver value quickly through small, testable increments.

7. Expected Outcomes

AI Foundry enables Coopbank to:

Deliver transformation projects with clear, measurable impact

Grow AI literacy and capability across teams

Standardize and scale transformation practices

Ensure accountability through structured systems and audit trails

Build a permanent, continuously improving innovation engine

8. Summary

AI Foundry replaces ad-hoc experimentation with disciplined, measurable transformation. It empowers Coopbank staff with clear roles, robust tools, and transparent operating methods. More than a project, AI Foundry is Coopbank’s operating system for AI-enabled transformation, ensuring innovation is strategic, scalable, and aligned with institutional goals.

9. Governance Note

This document serves as the authoritative reference for AI Foundry’s structure, purpose, roles, and accountabilities. It governs all AI-driven transformation initiatives across Coopbank.
